# Overview

This notebook describes clonal haematopoiesis (CH) called from blood exome
sequencing with HemaClone, which calls somatic variants in a panel of
CH genes and classifies each sample as CH positive or negative.

Without a matched non-haematopoietic sample, a somatic call in blood DNA is not
specific to clonal haematopoiesis. It can also reflect tumour cells or tumour
DNA in blood, clones selected by prior cytotoxic therapy, constitutional
mosaicism, a germline variant absent from population databases, or a
sequencing artefact. Germline heterozygous variants are excluded by design
through the allele fraction ceiling and the population frequency filter, so
inherited risk is not assessed. Calls are therefore reported as somatic blood
variants consistent with CH, and are candidates to review before they are read
as clonal haematopoiesis.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(maftools)
library(yaml)

# Rendered by the ch_report step of the workflow (workflow/scripts/render_report.R),
# with the project folder holding chip/ and logs/, the folder for the CSV
# exports, and an optional file of sample IDs to leave out.
PROJECT_DIR <- params$project_dir
RESULTS_DIR <- params$results_dir

if (!nzchar(PROJECT_DIR)) {
  stop("Set the project folder: rmarkdown::render(..., params = list(project_dir = \"/path\"))")
}
if (!dir.exists(PROJECT_DIR)) {
  stop("PROJECT_DIR not found: ", PROJECT_DIR)
}
if (!dir.exists(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "chip"))) {
  stop("No chip/ folder inside PROJECT_DIR: ", PROJECT_DIR)
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = PROJECT_DIR)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# Inputs

## Files and thresholds

The thresholds are read from the settings recorded by the workflow run that
produced the tables, so the values reported here are the ones that were
applied.

```{r inputs}
input_files <- c(
  samples    = "chip/chip_samples.tsv",
  calls      = "chip/chip_calls.maf",
  oncoplot   = "chip/chip_calls.oncoplot.maf",
  candidates = "chip/chip_candidates.tsv"
)

missing_inputs <- input_files[!file.exists(input_files)]
if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
  print(list.files("chip"))
  stop("Missing inputs: ", paste(missing_inputs, collapse = ", "))
}

# Most recent real run (not a dry run) whose settings carry a chip block
settings_files <- sort(list.files("logs/batches", pattern = "^run_.*_settings\\.yaml$",
                                  full.names = TRUE))
settings_list <- lapply(settings_files, yaml::read_yaml)
usable <- vapply(settings_list,
                 function(s) !is.null(s$chip) && !isTRUE(s$run$dry_run),
                 logical(1))
if (!any(usable)) stop("No run settings with a chip block in logs/batches/")
settings      <- settings_list[[max(which(usable))]]
settings_file <- settings_files[[max(which(usable))]]

thresholds <- c(
  min_depth        = settings$ch_filter$min_dp,
  min_vaf          = settings$ch_filter$min_vaf,
  max_vaf          = settings$chip$max_vaf,
  large_clone_vaf  = settings$chip$large_clone_vaf,
  min_alt_reads    = settings$chip$min_alt_reads,
  max_binom_p      = settings$chip$max_binom_p,
  max_gnomad_af    = settings$chip$max_gnomad_af,
  max_sor          = settings$chip$max_sor,
  indel_min_vaf               = settings$chip$indel_min_vaf,
  indel_min_alt_reads         = settings$chip$indel_min_alt_reads,
  repeat_indel_min_vaf        = settings$chip$repeat_indel_min_vaf,
  repeat_indel_min_alt_reads  = settings$chip$repeat_indel_min_alt_reads
)

message("Settings: ", settings_file, " | workflow ", settings$workflow$version)
data.frame(threshold = names(thresholds), value = unname(thresholds))
```

## Data loading

Samples without a qualifying call are negatives and stay in every denominator.

```{r load}
n_report <- function(df, label) {
  message(sprintf("%-40s n = %d", label, nrow(df)))
  df
}

as_flag <- function(x) toupper(as.character(x)) == "TRUE"

# Samples left out of this report (report.exclude_samples): one ID per line,
# blank lines and lines starting with # ignored. The workflow tables in chip/
# keep every sample; filtered copies are loaded here.
excluded <- character(0)
if (nzchar(params$exclude_samples)) {
  if (!file.exists(params$exclude_samples)) {
    stop("Exclusion list not found: ", params$exclude_samples)
  }
  ids <- trimws(sub("#.*$", "", readLines(params$exclude_samples, warn = FALSE)))
  excluded <- unique(ids[nzchar(ids)])
  cohort_ids <- read.delim(input_files[["samples"]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)$Tumor_Sample_Barcode
  unknown <- setdiff(excluded, cohort_ids)
  if (length(unknown) > 0) {
    stop("Excluded IDs not in the cohort: ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "))
  }
  filtered_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "filtered")
  dir.create(filtered_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (key in names(input_files)) {
    is_maf <- grepl("\\.maf$", input_files[[key]])
    table <- read.delim(input_files[[key]], comment.char = if (is_maf) "#" else "",
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    table <- table[!table$Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% excluded, , drop = FALSE]
    path <- file.path(filtered_dir, basename(input_files[[key]]))
    write.table(table, path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    input_files[[key]] <- path
  }
  message("Excluded samples (", length(excluded), "): ", paste(excluded, collapse = ", "))
}

ch_samples <- read.delim(input_files[["samples"]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                         check.names = FALSE) %>%
  n_report("samples") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gnomad_checked  = as_flag(gnomad_checked),
    CHIP_status     = factor(CHIP_status, levels = c("CHIP+", "CHIP-")),
    has_large_clone = factor(ifelse(as_flag(has_large_clone), "yes", "no"),
                             levels = c("yes", "no"))
  )

if (!all(ch_samples$gnomad_checked)) {
  stop("gnomAD criterion not applied for: ",
       paste(ch_samples$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[!ch_samples$gnomad_checked], collapse = ", "))
}

# Qualifying calls only, for every analysis of the calls themselves
n_positive <- sum(ch_samples$CHIP_status == "CHIP+")
if (n_positive > 0) {
  ch_maf <- maftools::read.maf(
    maf          = input_files[["calls"]],
    clinicalData = dplyr::filter(ch_samples, CHIP_status == "CHIP+"),
    verbose      = FALSE
  )
  ch_calls <- as.data.frame(ch_maf@data) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(t_vaf = as.numeric(t_vaf), t_depth = as.numeric(t_depth))
} else {
  ch_maf   <- NULL
  ch_calls <- data.frame()
}
ch_calls <- n_report(ch_calls, "qualifying calls")

# Whole cohort for the oncoplot: one Silent placeholder per CH- sample keeps
# negatives in the plot and in its denominator. maftools cannot load a MAF
# made of placeholders only, so it is loaded when at least one sample is CH+.
onco_table <- read.delim(input_files[["oncoplot"]], comment.char = "#",
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
onco_ids   <- unique(as.character(onco_table$Tumor_Sample_Barcode))

ch_maf_onco <- NULL
if (n_positive > 0) {
  ch_maf_onco <- maftools::read.maf(maf = input_files[["oncoplot"]],
                                    clinicalData = ch_samples, verbose = FALSE)
}

if (!setequal(onco_ids, ch_samples$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)) {
  stop("Samples differ between the oncoplot MAF and the sample table: ",
       paste(sort(setdiff(union(onco_ids, ch_samples$Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
                          intersect(onco_ids, ch_samples$Tumor_Sample_Barcode))),
             collapse = ", "))
}

candidates <- read.delim(input_files[["candidates"]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                         check.names = FALSE) %>%
  n_report("candidate calls")

criteria_cols <- grep("^pass_", names(candidates), value = TRUE)
candidates <- candidates %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(criteria_cols, "qualifies", "counts_for_status")),
                              as_flag))
```

```{r excluded, results = "asis"}
if (length(excluded) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("**Samples left out of this report (%d):** %s. The workflow tables in `chip/` include them.\n",
              length(excluded), paste(excluded, collapse = ", ")))
}
```

# Variant Calling and Filtering

```{r methods_values, include=FALSE}
panel_text <- paste0("the CH gene panel (", basename(settings$reference$gene_panel_bed), ")")

wgs <- identical(settings$data_type, "wgs")
input_text <- paste0(
  "FASTQ pairs were verified to decompress completely, with matching read ",
  "counts and read names in the same order in both mates. BAM and CRAM input ",
  "was checked for a valid header and end-of-file marker, and its read pairs ",
  "were extracted, with the original base qualities when recorded, for re-alignment.")
bqsr_text <- if (wgs) {
  paste0("over the GATK WGS calling regions, using dbSNP and the Mills and 1000 Genomes ",
         "indels as known sites; the recalibrated alignments were kept for the gene panel ",
         "and the contamination sites only")
} else {
  "over the exome capture targets, using dbSNP and the Mills and 1000 Genomes indels as known sites"
}

pon_text <- if (is.null(settings$pon$vcf)) {
  "No panel of normals was used."
} else if (settings$pon$mode == "annotate") {
  paste0("Calls at sites present in a panel of normals (", basename(settings$pon$vcf),
         ") were flagged rather than removed at this stage.")
} else {
  paste0("Sites present in a panel of normals (", basename(settings$pon$vcf),
         ") were filtered at calling.")
}
pon_criterion <- if (is.null(settings$pon$vcf)) {
  "not applicable, no panel of normals was used"
} else {
  paste0("absent from the panel of normals, except at ",
         length(settings$chip$pon_exempt_hotspots),
         " known CH hotspots (", paste(sub(":p\\.", " ", settings$chip$pon_exempt_hotspots),
                                       collapse = ", "), ")")
}
```

Blood `r if (wgs) "genome" else "exome"` samples were processed with HemaClone
version `r settings$workflow$version` (GATK `r settings$tools$gatk_version`),
without a matched normal. Tool versions and reference files are listed in the
methods record (`methods_report.html`).

1. **Input check.** `r input_text`
2. **Alignment.** Reads were aligned to hg38 (`r basename(settings$reference$fasta)`)
   with bwa-mem2, ALT-aware when the reference has ALT contigs, one read group
   per sequencing lane, then coordinate sorted.
3. **Duplicate marking.** Lanes of the same sample were merged and PCR and
   optical duplicates marked.
4. **Base quality recalibration.** Base qualities were recalibrated
   `r bqsr_text`.
5. **Somatic calling.** Mutect2 was run in tumour-only mode on
   `r panel_text`, with gnomAD allele frequencies as germline resource.
6. **Artefact models.** A read orientation model and a per-sample
   contamination estimate, from pileups at common variant sites, were passed
   to FilterMutectCalls, and only PASS calls were kept.
7. **Panel of normals.** `r pon_text`
8. **Depth and allele fraction.** Per sample, calls with depth below
   `r thresholds[["min_depth"]]` or VAF below `r thresholds[["min_vaf"]]` were
   removed.
9. **Annotation.** The gnomAD allele frequency of each call was added by
   matching position and allele, and calls were annotated with Funcotator
   (`r basename(settings$reference$funcotator_ds)`).

A call was retained as clonal haematopoiesis when it met all of the following:

- protein-altering consequence (`r paste(gsub("_", " ", settings$chip$variant_classes), collapse = ", ")`)
- at least `r thresholds[["min_alt_reads"]]` reads supporting the alternate allele
- depth of at least `r thresholds[["min_depth"]]` and VAF between
  `r thresholds[["min_vaf"]]` and `r thresholds[["max_vaf"]]`
- VAF significantly below the heterozygous fraction of 0.5, by a one-sided
  binomial test at p < `r thresholds[["max_binom_p"]]`
- gnomAD allele frequency of at most `r thresholds[["max_gnomad_af"]]`, with
  variants absent from gnomAD retained
- `r pon_criterion`
- strand odds ratio, from the reads supporting each allele on each strand, of
  at most `r thresholds[["max_sor"]]`
- indels: VAF of at least `r thresholds[["indel_min_vaf"]]` and at least
  `r thresholds[["indel_min_alt_reads"]]` alternate reads; indels in a tandem
  repeat or homopolymer (flagged by Mutect2, or in the GIAB tandem repeat and
  homopolymer regions), VAF of at least `r thresholds[["repeat_indel_min_vaf"]]`
  and at least `r thresholds[["repeat_indel_min_alt_reads"]]` alternate reads.
  The higher of these and the general thresholds applies.

A sample was classified as CH positive with at least one retained call, in any
panel gene except `r paste(settings$chip$status_exclude_genes, collapse = ", ")`,
which were reported but not counted. A clone was considered large at VAF of at
least `r thresholds[["large_clone_vaf"]]`.

# Quality Control

## Filtering overview

Each candidate call is counted against the criteria it fails. The calls
removed by a single criterion show which threshold the result depends on most,
and are the first to revisit if that threshold changes.

```{r filtering, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5, out.width="80%"}
fail_matrix <- !as.matrix(candidates[, criteria_cols, drop = FALSE])

filter_summary <- data.frame(
  criterion         = sub("^pass_", "", criteria_cols),
  failing           = colSums(fail_matrix),
  failing_only_this = colSums(fail_matrix & rowSums(fail_matrix) == 1),
  row.names = NULL
)

message("Candidates: ", nrow(candidates),
        " | qualifying: ", sum(candidates$qualifies),
        " | counted for CH status: ", sum(candidates$counts_for_status))
filter_summary

filter_summary %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(failing, failing_only_this), names_to = "count", values_to = "calls") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(criterion, calls), y = calls, fill = count)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(failing = "#9ECAE1", failing_only_this = "#2171B5"),
                    labels = c("failing", "failing this criterion only")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Candidate calls", fill = NULL)
```

## Allele fraction

Clonal expansions are minority populations, so qualifying calls should sit
well below the heterozygous fraction of 0.5. Candidates near 0.5 or 1.0 are
germline variants, and their exclusion is visible as the gap between the two
distributions.

```{r vaf, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, out.width="90%"}
candidates %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = ifelse(counts_for_status, "qualifying", "excluded")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = t_vaf, fill = group)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, position = "identity", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = thresholds[["min_vaf"]], linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = thresholds[["large_clone_vaf"]], linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = thresholds[["max_vaf"]], linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, colour = "grey50") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(excluded = "grey70", qualifying = "#B2182B")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Blood VAF", y = "Calls", fill = NULL)
```

## Strand bias

Artefacts from library preparation or alignment are often supported by reads
from one strand only. The strand odds ratio (SOR) is low when the alternate
reads are spread across both strands like the reference reads, and grows with
strand imbalance.

```{r strand, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, out.width="90%"}
if (nrow(candidates) == 0 || !"sor" %in% names(candidates)) {
  message("No strand odds ratio in the candidate table.")
} else {
  candidates %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = ifelse(pass_strand, "SOR within threshold", "SOR above threshold")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = sor, fill = group)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = thresholds[["max_sor"]], linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("SOR within threshold" = "#9ECAE1",
                                 "SOR above threshold"  = "#B2182B")) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "Strand odds ratio", y = "Candidate calls", fill = NULL)
}
```

## Indels in repeats

Polymerase slippage in tandem repeats and homopolymers produces indel
artefacts at low allele fractions, so indels there need more support. Each
point is an indel candidate; the dashed lines mark the thresholds for indels
in repeats, the dotted lines those for other indels.

```{r indels, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, out.width="90%"}
indels <- data.frame()
if (all(c("is_indel", "in_repeat") %in% names(candidates))) {
  indels <- candidates %>%
    dplyr::filter(as_flag(is_indel)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(t_alt_count = as.numeric(t_alt_count),
                  region = ifelse(as_flag(in_repeat), "repeat or homopolymer", "other"))
}
if (nrow(indels) == 0) {
  message("No indel candidates.")
} else {
  print(dplyr::count(indels, region, qualifies))
  print(
    ggplot(indels, aes(x = t_alt_count, y = t_vaf, colour = region, shape = qualifies)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = thresholds[["repeat_indel_min_vaf"]], linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = thresholds[["repeat_indel_min_alt_reads"]], linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = thresholds[["indel_min_vaf"]], linetype = "dotted") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = thresholds[["indel_min_alt_reads"]], linetype = "dotted") +
      scale_x_log10() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c("repeat or homopolymer" = "#B2182B", other = "#2171B5")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1)) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(x = "Alternate reads (log scale)", y = "Blood VAF", colour = NULL, shape = "qualifies")
  )
}
```

## Calls per sample

Most blood samples carry few candidate calls in a gene panel. A sample with
many more candidates than the rest points to a technical cause first:
contamination, low library quality or an alignment problem (see the QC report,
`qc_report.html`).

```{r per_sample, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, out.width="90%"}
calls_per_sample <- ch_samples %>%
  dplyr::select(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, n_candidates, n_CHIP_mutations) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_candidates = as.numeric(n_candidates)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_candidates))

calls_per_sample %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(n_candidates, n_CHIP_mutations), names_to = "calls", values_to = "n") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(calls = ifelse(calls == "n_candidates", "candidate", "qualifying, counted")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, fill = calls)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, position = "identity", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(candidate = "grey60", "qualifying, counted" = "#B2182B")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Calls per sample", y = "Samples", fill = NULL)

head(calls_per_sample, 10)
```

## Recurrent positions

Independent clonal events rarely share an exact coordinate across unrelated
individuals, except at known hotspots. A recurrent position outside a hotspot
is more likely an artefact or a germline variant, and is the first call to
review.

```{r recurrent}
recurrent_pos <- data.frame()
if (nrow(ch_calls) > 0) {
  recurrent_pos <- ch_calls %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Chromosome, Start_Position, Hugo_Symbol, Protein_Change) %>%
    dplyr::count(Chromosome, Start_Position, Hugo_Symbol, Protein_Change, name = "n_samples") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_samples > 1) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_samples))
}

if (nrow(recurrent_pos) == 0) message("No position is shared by more than one sample.")
recurrent_pos
```

# Clonal Haematopoiesis Landscape

## Prevalence

A sample is CH positive when it carries at least one qualifying call in a gene
that counts for status; clone size is reported separately, with a large clone
defined by the VAF boundary above.

```{r prevalence}
ch_samples %>%
  dplyr::count(CHIP_status, has_large_clone, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n / nrow(ch_samples), 1))

ch_samples %>%
  dplyr::select(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, CHIP_status, n_CHIP_mutations, max_VAF,
                has_large_clone, genes_mutated, other_genes_qualifying) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(CHIP_status, dplyr::desc(max_VAF))
```

## Cohort summary

Distribution of variant classes and types across the qualifying calls, and
the number of calls per sample.

```{r summary, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, out.width="100%"}
if (nrow(ch_calls) > 0) {
  maftools::plotmafSummary(maf = ch_maf, rmOutlier = FALSE, addStat = "median",
                           dashboard = TRUE, titvRaw = FALSE)
} else {
  message("No qualifying calls: nothing to summarise.")
}
```

## Oncoplot

Every sample is shown, negatives included, annotated by CH status and by the
presence of a large clone.

```{r oncoplot, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, out.width="100%"}
if (nrow(ch_calls) > 0) {
  maftools::oncoplot(
    maf                     = ch_maf_onco,
    genes                   = head(maftools::getGeneSummary(ch_maf)$Hugo_Symbol, 30),
    clinicalFeatures        = c("CHIP_status", "has_large_clone"),
    annotationColor         = list(
      CHIP_status     = c("CHIP+" = "#B2182B", "CHIP-" = "#D9D9D9"),
      has_large_clone = c(yes = "#2166AC", no = "#F0F0F0")
    ),
    anno_height             = 2,
    sortByAnnotation        = TRUE,
    annotationOrder         = c("CHIP+", "CHIP-"),
    showTumorSampleBarcodes = TRUE,
    barcode_mar             = 10,
    drawRowBar              = TRUE,
    drawColBar              = TRUE
  )
}
```

## Clone size by gene

Allele fraction of each qualifying call, grouped by gene. For a heterozygous
mutation, the share of blood cells carrying the clone is about twice its VAF.

```{r clone_size, fig.width=9, fig.height=6, out.width="90%"}
if (nrow(ch_calls) > 0) {
  maftools::plotVaf(maf = ch_maf, vafCol = "t_vaf", top = 20)
}
```

## Mutation positions

Position of the calls along the protein for genes mutated more than once. A
cluster at a single residue points to a hotspot; calls spread across the
protein are typical of loss-of-function genes.

```{r lollipop, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, out.width="100%"}
lollipop_genes <- character(0)
if (!is.null(ch_maf)) {
  gene_summary   <- maftools::getGeneSummary(ch_maf)
  lollipop_genes <- gene_summary$Hugo_Symbol[gene_summary$total >= 2]
}

if (length(lollipop_genes) == 0) message("No gene is mutated more than once.")
for (g in lollipop_genes) {
  # capture.output drops the transcript table printed alongside the plot
  tryCatch(
    invisible(capture.output(
            maftools::lollipopPlot(maf = ch_maf, gene = g, AACol = "Protein_Change",
                             showMutationRate = TRUE,
                             showDomainLabel = FALSE)
    )),
    error = function(e) message("Skipped ", g, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
  )
}
```

write.csv(ch_samples,     file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "ch_samples.csv"),             row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(recurrent_pos,  file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "ch_recurrent_positions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(filter_summary, file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "ch_filter_summary.csv"),      row.names = FALSE)
